title: PlasmaZones Surface Shader Metadata
description: metadata.json for a bundled or user surface (decoration) shader pack. Core identity and the parameter contract are required. The optional compositing and multipass keys (providesBorder, providesOpacityTint, needsBackdrop, interiorOpaque, multipass, bufferShaders, bufferScale, bufferScales, bufferFeedback, bufferWrap, bufferWraps, bufferFilter, bufferFilters, depthBuffer, halfFloatBuffers, animated, audio, paddingParam, vertexShader, textures, and the retired handlesOpacity), the named parameter presets and the descriptive metadata (description, author, version, category, preview) are type-checked and bounded here, not merely tolerated, and an unknown top-level key is rejected. The per-pass bufferScales list is surface-only, because the overlay and animation families carry a single bufferScale for the whole chain.

handlesOpacity.description: Retired and ignored. Opacity is layer-backed now, so packs no longer declare it: the compositor folds the window's resolved opacity into the chain's opacity-tint layer, and the other layers never see it. Accepted only so pre-existing pack metadata still validates.

bufferScales.description: Per-pass render scale, one entry per bufferShaders entry, which is what lets a pyramid such as a dual Kawase diverge its levels. This list is surface-only, because the overlay and animation families declare a single bufferScale for the whole chain. An empty array says nothing and is a mistake rather than a default, so it is rejected.

depthBuffer.description: Allocate a depth attachment alongside the colour FBO so a pass can sample window depth. DAEMON-ONLY, and that matters more here than in the other families: the compositor implements no depth buffer for surface packs, and the compositor is where a decoration lives on a real window, so a pack that samples depth looks one way in the settings preview and another on screen. The surface family also ships no depth module to include, unlike data/overlays/shared/depth.glsl, so declare `layout(binding = 16) uniform sampler2D uDepthBuffer;` yourself. Setting it also discards bufferScales on the daemon, because every pass shares the one depth attachment and must match its size. plasmazones-shader-validate reports all of this.

presets.description: Named parameter presets. Each value is a map of parameter id to value, naming a subset of the pack's declared parameters. A preset id is its key here, and it is also the label the picker shows, so it has to read as a name. That rules out control and bidi-formatting characters, and anything longer than a label can show. Unlike a user preset id it never becomes a filename, because duplicating a pack preset mints a fresh UUID. A null value is allowed and means the preset says nothing about that parameter, so it keeps the pack's default; the loader drops the entry. Those rules are checked by plasmazones-shader-validate rather than here, because the vendored JSON-schema validator rejects every name under a propertyNames rule, legitimate ones included.

type.description: Marshalling type of the uniform. Images are declared under `textures`, not as parameters. An unknown type cannot be bound, so it is rejected.

default.description: Default value. Use a string for color (#aarrggbb), a number for float or int, and a boolean for bool.
